授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
Hydraulics is one of the fundamental and common subjects in Civil Engineering. Especially, it relates on the topics of water natural hazard, such as floods, tsunami, storm surge, and so on, and also aquatic environmental problems, such as pollutant transport in natural waters, deterioration of riverine and marine ecosystem, etc.
In this lecture, students learn theoretical backgrounds of hydraulics and fluid mechanics in order to understand features of water flows.
